components.name: method
values: mosaic platform | spheroids of mixed cell lines 50 cell lines per spheroid were cultured in suspension treated with drug or dmso for 24 hours dissociated into single cells fixed and profiled using the parse gigalab scrna-seq kit with combinatorial barcoding. genetic variants in scrna-seq libraries were used for snp-based deconvolution. 14 96-well plates were processed into 1 786 sublibraries. sequencing yielded 1.4 trillion reads representing 153 million cells.

scvi dimensionality reduction | scvi was used to learn a 10-dimensional embedding for each cell. for visualization 140 000 high-quality cells per cell line were sampled 6.58 million total and 2-d tsne coordinates computed.
